note: OPRHP, 2 miles south of Dansville; gravel sites in three loops at the south entrance. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (matches), ReserveAmerica booking, no electric, 88 back-in sites, max 40 ft (one site; most 20-30 ft), dump; 1-night minimum, 9-month window and 14-night max now recorded; showers, flush toilets, water fill added. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note: dropped site/hookup/dump/length/booking restatements. Water/sewer false left (derived; the site list says only 'Full Hookup - no').
flags: Minor: only one site is listed at 40 ft and 33 at 30 ft; 29 are listed at 20-25 ft and 25 have no length, so a 23-ft rig must pick its site.
